title: LangGraph：共有state＋関数＋分岐＋止めて、続ける

status.authored: 8 source files of this conceptual introduction (index.html, concept.css, concept.js, video/index.html, video/video.css, video/video.js, video/storyboard.json, video/README.md), written by claude-opus-5-5
status.note: Written without running a browser, renderer, Python or tests. Rendering, frame review, encoding, packaging and publication are later steps by the production operator; nothing here claims they passed. This storyboard records the intended scenes, not an execution log.

diagram.idea: One connected moving map shared with ../index.html (../concept.js). One state card travels the real route, gains fields from the saved checkpoints, waits at the review gate, and leaves as a saved record. Portrait and wide are separate native arrangements of the same map.

nodes.authoring: 原典API ＋ 依頼文 → one circle 元の制作AI → workflow.py paper. This is the original authoring by Opus 5.5, shown once; the AI is not part of the running graph.
nodes.operator: 制作担当 ▶ Python box → compile pill → invoke pill → START. The operator ran Python in a separate step; compile carries the InMemorySaver (dashed tie to the memory tray in portrait).
nodes.graph: LangGraph zone labelled 規則で動く5関数 / 紙＝共有state: START → validate → diamond fork → estimate → review (gate with posts, 'interrupt', sliding amber bar) → finalize → END; side branch 不足 → needs_input → END. The fork label is input validity (不足 / そろう), not amount or approval.
nodes.card: The shared state card. Phases are saved checkpoints of the selected job: RequestState (field names only) → 申請（入力）(items) → validated → awaiting_review (sku unit×quantity, 合計, 予算フラグ) → 停止 stamp at review → approved/rejected (+テスト回答) → final (+要約). Missing: needs_input with 不足 end_date and 要約, never a total.
nodes.memory: InMemorySaver / プロセス内メモリ tray with three thread slots A/B/C; small sheets are the saved snapshots of that thread (6/4/6 at the end, counts of records, not scores).
nodes.reply: Command card: テスト値 true / false from inputs/requests.json; for B it reads 停止なし. Path: reply → memory slot of the same thread → back into the top of review, labelled 先頭から.
nodes.outputs: 保存記録 <id>.json paper → 元の実データ desk.html screen.

diagram.explanatory_shapes: Paper, gate, tray, screen and token shapes are diagram drawings, not execution evidence. The film never shows a human approval UI, a disk or server store, a restart, or resume starting at finalize.

The bar opens, the card becomes approved with テスト回答 true, moves to finalize (+要約), passes END into 保存記録 approved.json, and a file token reaches 元の実データ. Strip chip A appears at 18.1 s.

data.gate: concept/manifest.json (SHA-256 3147f2fff01f9ae8e548ebd4af6084648f357232d49b0bdb2530916feaedf4ed) lists 21 frozen files; every file is checked for size and SHA-256 and the records for meaning before anything is drawn
data.values_from: concept/jobs/{approved,missing,rejected}.json, the same objects as outputs/runs.json jobs[0..2]; card phases read checkpoints[1..5].values
never: new graph execution or Python run
invented zero cost or pause for the missing request

limits: LangGraph is a Python library; the six parts are an explanatory grouping of selected APIs, not an upstream schema; the five runtime nodes are deterministic Python functions, not five AIs.
The branch depends only on missing or invalid input; every complete request stops at review, including 8,000円 with budget_flag false; budget_flag true is only a flag.
Test replies are scripted values, not human approval; no booking, stock reservation, notification or payment.
InMemorySaver keeps state in the memory of one Python process; no disk/server/cloud persistence or restart was tested.
crypto.subtle is required (HTTPS or localhost); without it the page and film stop with a clear message.
